You are walking along a straight corridor 1.75 m wide. Another person, Person 2, is walking towards you, facing you, 6 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are. Person 2 says: "Go ahead, plenty of room on your right." (Person 2 is facing you: their left is your right, and their right is your left.) Which way do you move, left or right?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Right
“Your right” refers to the addressee’s own right side, regardless of Person 2 facing you.
